text:
alex: Hey all — noticed intermittent p99 spikes on H100 for long-context runs (8k seq, batch=1, fp16). A100 looks more stable. Can someone help repro or point to recent bench artifacts?

mari: I remember a similar blip last month on staging. Might be cache eviction or a kernel fallback. Do you have the exact bench command and env?

alex: Yep, here's what I ran locally: 
```
./bench_runner --model redwood-v1-7b --sku h100 --seq-len 8192 --batch 1 --iters 600 --quant=fp16 --kv-cache=on --kernel-auto=true
```

jordan: quick q — are you using continuous batching or single-stream microbench? that changes perf a lot for p99.

alex: single-stream (no batching). Trying to isolate tail latency.

sam: pinging to run a quick cross-sku: H100 vs A100 vs L40s with same flags. I can queue jobs but need GPU ETA (~2h). Which region/GPU pool should I pick?

mari: use pool:eng-runtime-us-west (has H100/A100). For L40s use eng-runtime-eu (we only have L40s in eu for now).

jordan: small hypothesis — when sequence crosses certain KV cache thresholds kernel selection flips and we see +20–40ms p99. Try forcing kernel-auto=false and set --kernel=optimized_attn_v2 to compare.

alex: good call. Running with kernel pinned now. If anyone else can run the same, we can compare.

ci-bot: queued bench jobs: job/7891 (h100-us-west), job/7892 (a100-us-west), job/7893 (l40s-eu). I'll post results when done. :robot_face:

sam: FYI I'll also run a run with --kv-cache=off to see delta.

mari: also check driver/cudnn versions. We had one cluster with cudnn 8.6 that showed regressions.

ci-bot: results (summary):
- h100-us-west  : p50=48ms  p95=138ms  p99=218ms  (kernel=auto)
- a100-us-west  : p50=46ms  p95=125ms  p99=190ms  (kernel=auto)
- l40s-eu       : p50=51ms  p95=144ms  p99=225ms  (kernel=auto)
Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/7891/summary.json, s3://redwood-bench/7892/summary.json, s3://redwood-bench/7893/summary.json

alex: thanks — CI numbers match my local-ish numbers. p99 gap is real.

jordan: can you try the pinned kernel run (kernel=optimized_attn_v2) on H100 and post new p99? If that drops a lot then we know kernel selection is culprit.

sam: ran kv-cache=off on H100 (job/7894): p99=162ms (kernel=auto). So KV cache seems to be contributing ~50ms tail.

mari: interesting — that points to cache pressure. Could be memory allocator churn or a specific attention kernel fallback when cache > X.

alex: I just kicked a pinned-kernel H100 job (job/7895). Will paste output when CI-bot posts.

ci-bot: job/7895 (h100, kernel=optimized_attn_v2) results: p50=47ms p95=130ms p99=172ms. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/7895/summary.json

alex: that's a ~46ms improvement on p99 vs auto. Cool — kernel selection is likely the root cause.

jordan: next steps: 1) add kernel-pinning experiment to perf harness, 2) add telemetry to log kernel selection on prod requests >5k tokens, 3) open infra ticket to check cudnn/driver matrix. I'll take (1) and (2).

mari: I'll open infra ticket for driver matrix and check node labels for affected pools.

sam: will schedule a longer soak on H100 with pinned kernel and kv-cache=on to ensure no regression for throughput.

alex: huge thanks. For the write-up: I'll collect the artifacts and draft a short perf note with commands, ci links, and recommended short-term mitigations (pin kernel for long-context H100 runs).

jordan: :thumbsup: post the note in #eng-runtime and @oncall if you plan a prod change.

alex: Will do. Leaving the thread open for a bit for any other suggestions. Thanks everyone!
